queries: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(daily) AS avg_daily FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(p.daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(p.daily - o.avg_daily) AS avg_daily_excess FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.daily > o.avg_daily

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), x AS (SELECT r.*, AVG(avg_daily) OVER () AS overall_daily FROM r) SELECT AVG(avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(avg_daily - overall_daily) AS avg_excess FROM x WHERE avg_daily > overall_daily

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), t AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily) AS overall FROM r), k AS (SELECT r.*, t.overall FROM r CROSS JOIN t WHERE r.avg_daily > t.overall) SELECT AVG(avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(avg_daily - overall) AS avg_excess FROM k

responses.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(daily) AS avg_daily FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(p.daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(p.daily - o.avg_daily) AS avg_daily_excess FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.daily > o.avg_daily

assumptions.assumption: The cross-rating average is the simple (unweighted) mean of the five ratings' average daily prices, as the request states, and the filter is strictly greater than that mean.
All films are included (no filtering by inventory or rentals); rental_duration is never zero per the verified data (3 to 7).

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), x AS (SELECT r.*, AVG(avg_daily) OVER () AS overall_daily FROM r) SELECT AVG(avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(avg_daily - overall_daily) AS avg_excess FROM x WHERE avg_daily > overall_daily

assumptions.assumption: The cross-rating average is the simple (unweighted) mean of the per-rating average daily prices across all 5 ratings, computed before filtering.
Films with a NULL rating, if any, would form their own group; the verified data shows exactly 5 ratings, so this is not expected to matter.

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), t AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily) AS overall FROM r), k AS (SELECT r.*, t.overall FROM r CROSS JOIN t WHERE r.avg_daily > t.overall) SELECT AVG(avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(avg_daily - overall) AS avg_excess FROM k

assumptions.assumption: Ratings with NULL rating are excluded or irrelevant since the data shows exactly 5 rating levels; the cross-rating average is the simple mean of the 5 ratings' average daily prices.
The ratings' average replacement costs are averaged with equal weight (simple average of per-rating averages, not film-weighted).
